items.originalTitle: The Future Is for Everyone: Muse for Small Business

en.title: The Future Is for Everyone: Muse for Small Business
en.summary: Earlier this month we introduced Muse , a personal AI agent available in the US and Canada that completes tasks on your behalf.
en.details:
Earlier this month we introduced Muse , a personal AI agent available in the US and Canada that completes tasks on your behalf. Today, we’re expanding it with a collection of new skills and connectors inside Muse to help people run their businesses.

Small businesses have been growing on our apps for nearly two decades. They told us they’re short on hours, not ideas. So we built Muse for Small Business to help get work done with the tools they already use.

Tom Mulholland, owner of Mulholland Grocery in Malvern, Iowa, said, “I work about 65 hours a week, and there are so many things where I’m the only one who can do them. I need to free up time for the work that actually makes my business money: cutting the steaks, making the sausages. I’m very good at what I do, but that doesn’t mean I’m good at all of the different roles a small business owner has to play, and Muse is taking over a few of them.”

Built to Work With the Tools People Already Use To Run Their Businesses

Muse can connect your Instagram professional account analytics, Facebook Pages, and Meta ad accounts in a few clicks, and it already understands your business: what you sell, what your brand sounds like, and what customers keep asking you about.

Muse can also connect to dozens of tools that businesses already run on, so it can work with your brand, storefront, books, and customer records. …

en.title: 3.0.7 Bug Fixes (September 29)
en.summary: September 29 1. Added a batch management feature for custom server hosts. Server hosts can go to the Player Management page to perform batch operations such as deleting and removing players from the server.
en.details:
September 29

1. Added a batch management feature for custom server hosts. Server hosts can go to the Player Management page to perform batch operations such as deleting and removing players from the server.

The following issues are expected to be fixed by 04:30 PT. Actual completion time may vary:

1. Fixed an issue in Lightforge Loot Crates where the radiance display was incorrect for the Stellar Elite: Mistflow Set, Heartbound Vow: Thaumiel Set, and Windspeak Realm material skin.

2. Fixed an issue where the Abyssal Touch Set would still trigger tentacle VFX after hiding tentacles in transformed form (you can drag off the corresponding Top and re-equip it, or sign in to the game again for it to take effect).

items.originalTitle: New Microsoft data innovations unlock what only your business knows

en.title: New Microsoft data innovations unlock what only your business knows
en.summary: Every organization has knowledge that is uniquely its own: the way its business operates, the data it has built over time, the expertise of its people and the context behind thousands of everyday decisions.
en.details:
Every organization has knowledge that is uniquely its own: the way its business operates, the data it has built over time, the expertise of its people and the context behind thousands of everyday decisions.

As powerful AI models become more widely available, that unique business intelligence matters more than ever. The difference will come from how effectively organizations combine those models with the data, expertise and business context that make them unique.

Turning that intelligence into lasting advantage requires three elements to work together: human ambition to set the direction, intelligence grounded in the organization’s unique knowledge and trust to provide the foundation for operating at scale. Microsoft’s approach is designed to bring those elements together so organizations can build on what they know and create greater value over time.

That value can compound through a continuous learning loop, where AI draws on an organization’s data and expertise, improves the systems and experiences it creates and generates better outcomes over time without making the organization dependent on any single model provider.

Today at the European Microsoft Fabric + SQL Community Conference in Barcelona, we are introducing advances across Microsoft Fabric and Azure Databases that help organizations put their data estate at the heart of a successful AI strategy.
